response.sql: WITH inv_avg AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM inv_avg), dev AS (SELECT ia.InvoiceId, ia.Country, ia.avg_unit_price, ia.avg_unit_price - o.overall_avg AS deviation FROM inv_avg ia CROSS JOIN overall o) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM dev ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each invoice's average is over its InvoiceLine rows, so invoices with no lines have no average and are excluded from the overall average, the country averages, and the output.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-invoice averages, as the request says, so each invoice counts equally regardless of its line count.
An invoice's country is the country of its customer (Customer.Country), not the billing country on Invoice. Customers with a NULL country form one group via PARTITION BY.
Ties at the 10-row cutoff are broken arbitrarily by the engine, and no rounding is applied. NULLS LAST requires SQLite 3.30 or later or an equivalent dialect.
